name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Cherry Jolli Popz
description:
Rich, sweet, and candy-inspired, Cherry JolliPopz delivers bold cherry flavor with a smooth, satisfying finish. Packed into our advanced Max Pro device, this 3G disposable pairs nostalgic sweetness with next-level performance.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
